stories.title: Invented in India: Shampoo
stories.description: An ancient Indian healer explains how the idea of shampoo began in India as a ritual of health and care.

scenes.visual_prompt: Epic hero shot, ultra-cinematic medium close-up of an ancient Indian healer (male, 60–70 years old) in a lush herbal courtyard at dawn. Long silver-grey hair tied back, flowing beard, intense calm eyes, serene but powerful presence. Wearing traditional cotton robes. In front of him on a stone table lie fresh herbs, flowers, and a shallow bowl. Golden sunlight filters through leaves creating volumetric god-rays, floating dust and pollen particles. He is speaking directly to the camera while gently crushing herbs with his hands. Strong eye contact. Front-facing camera only. Chest and face square to camera. No side view, no profile, no angle change. Ultra-realistic, cinematic, HDR lighting, no text, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow powerful forward presence, rhythmic crushing of herbs, leaves and plants swaying in soft breeze, floating particles drifting, camera tracking backward on straight axis, continuous mouth and jaw movement while speaking, subtle cinematic camera breathing, no rotation, no orbit
scenes.narration: जो बालों की देखभाल आज आप करते हैं… उसकी शुरुआत इसी धरती से हुई थी।

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of an ancient Indian healer (male, 60–70 years old) standing in a quiet herbal workspace. Long grey beard, calm focused expression, steady eyes. Wearing simple cotton robes. A stone bowl filled with water sits before him as he mixes crushed reetha, shikakai, and amla by hand. The liquid gradually darkens. He speaks directly to the camera with clear lip and jaw movement. Front-facing camera only. Chest and face square to camera. No side view, no profile. Warm natural lighting, shallow depth-of-field, ultra-realistic, no text, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow circular hand motion mixing herbs and water, gentle ripples forming on liquid surface, subtle head nods for emphasis, continuous speaking mouth movement, stable framing, camera tracking backward on straight axis
scenes.narration: हज़ारों वर्ष पहले भारत में, हमने जड़ी-बूटियों को पानी में मिलाकर बालों की शुद्धि का तरीका खोजा।

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of an ancient Indian healer (male, 60–70 years old) carefully lifting the herbal liquid from a stone bowl with his hands. Long beard, thoughtful eyes, expression of quiet evaluation. Drops of liquid fall back into the bowl. He speaks directly to the camera, occasionally glancing at the liquid before returning eye contact. Front-facing camera only. No angle change. Warm earthy tones, cinematic realism, no text, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow lifting of liquid and letting it drip back into bowl, gentle inspection gestures, calm controlled body movement, continuous lip movement while speaking, stable framing
scenes.narration: यह तरल केवल मिश्रण नहीं था — यह बालों और त्वचा के लिए औषधि थी।

scenes.visual_prompt: Hero-style medium close-up of an ancient Indian healer (male, 60–70 years old) standing calmly with the herbal bowl before him. Long silver beard, knowing eyes, gentle smile of understanding. Behind him, the herbal liquid subtly blends into the faint silhouette of a modern shampoo bottle, symbolizing continuity through time. He speaks directly to the camera. Front-facing only. Chest and face square to camera. No side view. Cinematic lighting, shallow depth-of-field, no text, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: very slow forward movement easing into stillness, hands resting near the bowl, gentle nods of emphasis, continuous mouth movement, stable framing
scenes.narration: आज जब आप शैम्पू का उपयोग करते हैं, आप भारत की उसी खोज को दोहराते हैं।
